chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Sahl ibn Ziyad al-Adami narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Amr ibn Thabit, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, who raised it [to the Prophet]. He said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) visited his uncle Abu Talib while he was laid out [for burial]. So he said: O uncle! You adopted an orphan, you raised a child, and you supported an adult, so may God reward you with good on my behalf. Then he ordered Ali (peace be upon him) to wash him.

key_terms.غسل: Ghusl - ritual washing of the deceased, an important Islamic funerary rite
key_terms.كفلت: Kafalta - you adopted/sponsored; refers to Abu Talib taking guardianship of the young Muhammad after Abd al-Muttalib's death
key_terms.مسجى: Musajja - laid out for burial, shrouded; indicates Abu Talib had already passed away

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say when he visited Abu Talib after his death?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad's visit to his uncle Abu Talib after his death. The Prophet acknowledged Abu Talib's three great services: taking in the orphaned Muhammad after the death of Abd al-Muttalib, raising him as a child, and supporting his prophetic mission as an adult. The Prophet's supplication for Abu Talib and his instruction for Imam Ali to perform the ritual washing affirm Abu Talib's honored status in Shia tradition.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
